required by the specification; not scored
Dashed grey: not applicable to U01
(90: only one borehole shown); not in
Completeness = points marked MET ÷ applicable points
(b), (c) MET: 2 of 11 applicable (90 N/A: one borehole)
MD vs TVD. MD (measured depth) runs along the borehole; TVD (true
vertical depth) is the vertical depth of the same point. A row's MD and TVD
cells are one datum scored as two points; (b)–(c) points have no TVD pair.
U01 is deviated (15° to 30°) but reports MD only, so every TVD point is
MISSING. Repeated data are framed once.
